core.title: LCN 2016 Concealed Door Closer
tags: LCN 2010 Series Head Frame Mounted Concealed Door Closers

text.description_html:
LCN Concealed Overhead Door Closers

The Concealed LCN 2016 is designed to mount in the door frame. This heavy duty door closer is designed to provide complete concealment.

The single lever arm and roller assembly provide smooth, quiet door control. This is a handed closer with a spring size 6 and Aluminum finish.

The LCN 2016 designed for Exterior Doors 36" - 48". Dark Bronze finish.

LCN 2016 Installation Diagram (PDF).

This Handed door closer is UL and ULC listed for self-closing doors without hold-open and comes with a 15 year warranty. Tested and certified under ANSI Standard A156.4, Grade 1.

Packaged complete with door closer, mounting bracket, closer arm, track, roller and installation screws.

*Important When selecting Door Hand for this door closer:
1. Stand on the Push Side of the door, facing the door.
2. If the "Pivot Hinge" is on your "Left", choose "Left Hand Door".
3. If the "Pivot Hinge" is on your "Right", choose "Right Hand Door".
